title: Tassimo Espresso T Discs Recalled by Kraft Foods Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled espresso T Discs can become clogged and spray hot liquid and coffee grounds onto consumers and bystanders during or after brewing, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 2.1 million packages in the United States and an additional 1.9 million in Canada.

title: Tassimo Single-Cup Coffee Makers Recalled by BSH Home Appliances Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The plastic disc, or T Disc, that holds the coffee or tea can burst and spray hot liquid and coffee grounds or tea leaves onto consumers using the brewer and onto bystanders, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 835,000 in the United States and an additional 900,000 in Canada.

title: Spectrum Home Furnishings Recalls Chandeliers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled chandeliers contain a mounting loop that can fail during use causing the chandeliers to fall from the ceiling and injure bystanders under the chandelier. Units: About 165.

title: Designs Direct Recalls Rooster-Themed Lamps Sold Exclusively at Fred's Inc. Due to Risks of Shock and Fire
summary: The electrical cord can fray near the base of the lamp, posing a fire or shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,000.

title: Bumbleride Recalls Indie & Indie Twin Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front wheel can break at the axle hub, causing the stroller to tip and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 28,000 (an additional 2,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Fire Concerns Prompt York International to Reannounce Recall of Gas Furnaces for Manufactured Homes
summary: The furnace can overheat and cause the heat-exchanger to crack and create openings that allow flames to be exposed. title: Weeplay Kids Recalls Infant Bodysuits Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps can detach from the fabric of the garment, posing a choking hazard to infants and young children. Units: About 128,000.

title: HP Recalls Fax Machines Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The fax machines can overheat due to an internal electrical component failure, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 928,000 in the U.S. and 240,000 in Canada and Mexico.

title: Konica Minolta Recalls Printers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The printers can short circuit and overheat during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,430.

title: LTD Commodities Recalls Sleeper Ottomans Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The welding joints on the legs can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,650.

title: Overarching Floor Lamp Recalled by West Elm Due to Shock Hazard
summary: A short circuit can occur in the lamp's wiring, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,750.

title: Holiday Tea Light Candle Warmers Recalled by Christmas Tree Shops Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle warmers can catch fire because the warming bowl is positioned too close to the tea light candle, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,700.

title: Hurricane Style Lights Recalled by Christmas Tree Shops Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical short circuit can occur in the light's internal wiring, causing smoke and posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,500.

title: The Container Store Recalls Brightly-Colored Power Strips Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power strips have undersized wiring, and the wiring and plastic strip fail to meet the requirements for fire resistance, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,200.

title: ECHO Recalls Backpack Blowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel line between the fuel tank and carburetor could have been damaged during assembly leading to fuel leakage, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: Gas Cylinders Recalled by Worthington Cylinders Wisconsin Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The seal on the cylinders can leak after torches or other fuel consuming equipment are disconnected from them, posing a fire hazard. Units: 29,026,000 units in the U.S.; 1,371,100 units in Canada.

title: Kelty Recalls Jogging Strollers Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The front wheel can come loose during use and cause the stroller to tip over, posing a fall and injury hazard to children in the stroller and adults pushing the stroller. Units: About 3,000.

title: Suntech America Recalls SolarBlend Roof Tiles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The connectors between the solar roof tiles can become loose, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 300 installations.

title: 2GIG Technologies Recalls Modules Used In Go!Control Panels for Home Security Systems Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: GSM radio modules used inside Go!Control Panels for home security systems can overheat and combust, resulting in a fire or burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 40,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Touch Point Fan Heaters Due to Fire, Shock Hazards
summary: Exposed and unshielded electrical components can cause the heater to overheat and melt, posing fire and electrical shock hazards. Units: About 6,102.

title: American Honda Recalls ATVs due to Crash Hazard
summary: A weld on the ATV's front right upper suspension arm can separate, causing the driver to lose control of the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 2,900.

title: Fuji Recalls Women's Cruiser Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle's frame can break in the center of the downtube during use, causing the rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 10,500.

title: Pro Armor Recalls Latches for Utility Vehicle Doors Due to Ejection and Laceration Hazards
summary: The latch pin can disengage from the latch allowing the door to open while the vehicle is moving. This can pose a risk of ejection of an unrestrained rider and impact or laceration hazards. Units: About 5,200.

title: Shimano Recalls PRO Atherton Mountain Bike Handlebar Stems Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bolts holding the front plate of the stem to the stem body can be pulled out of the threads while the bike is being ridden, causing the rider to lose control of the bike and fall. Units: 213 in the United States; 83 in Canada.

title: Children's Slides Recalled by Landscape Structures due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Slalom Glider is a playground slide that lacks a transition platform on the top and sides on the chute. Children can fall when moving from the ladder to the slide and when descending the chute. Units: About 900.

title: Ganz Recalls Dancing Teapots Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The teapot's handle can get extremely hot when there is hot water in the teapot, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,100 in the United States and 170 in Canada.

title: Tumblekins Toys Recalled by International Playthings Due to Choking and Laceration Hazards
summary: The toys can break into small pieces with sharp points, posing choking and lacerations hazards to children. Units: About 31,000.

title: Fire Control Panels Recalled by Bosch Security Systems Corp. Due to Alarm Failure Posing a Fire Hazard
summary: On all systems, when the alarm verification feature of the system is turned on, the control panel can fail to sound an alarm if a fire occurs. In addition, on systems with 50 or more reporting stations, a delay in sounding an alarm and reporting a fire may occur if the loop for the alarm system is b

title: Improvements Catalog Recalls Adjustable Ottoman Beds Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When the ottoman is converted into a bed and weight is put on it, it can collapse, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 800.

title: STIHL Recalls Chain Saws Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The flywheel on the chain saw can crack causing parts of the flywheel to separate and strike users or bystanders, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 3,000.

title: Twin Oaks Recalls Hammock Stands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The foot brackets used to support the hammock can crack, causing the stand to collapse. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,300.

title: American Honda Recalls Trimmers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The shaft can crack and cause the lower gear case and cutting attachment to detach, posing a laceration hazard to the operator and bystanders. Units: About 14,000 in the United States and 3,600 in Canada.

title: Carlisle FoodService Recalls Melamine Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The cups and mugs can break when exposed to hot liquids, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 111,000.

title: Greenlee Recalls Utility Knives Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The blade locking mechanism can fail, allowing the blade to fold inward toward the handle, posing a laceration hazard. Units: 1800.

title: Papa Bear Loungeabouts Children's Pajamas Recalled by Retailers Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The garments fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injury to children. Units: Estimate of 10,000 plus.
